rubrics.justification: The response overcalls image quality and describes a prominent tightly packed ICM and cohesive AA TE that are not clearly visible in this image. It also labels the embryo as fully expanded/pre-hatching despite the image appearing more ambiguous and partially collapsed/obscured.

It integrates age, tubal factor, prior cycle, sperm parameters, endometrium, smoking, BMI, and oocyte yield with prognosis reasonably well, though AMH is unavailable and some inferences about low response are somewhat speculative.

The reasoning is generally logical and internally consistent, with a plausible probability estimate tied to embryo quality and patient factors. Minor issues include overstating morphology and assigning a fairly specific smoking penalty without strong case-specific support.

Recommendations are mostly consistent with IVF practice: SET for a good-quality day-5 blastocyst in a 34-year-old, luteal support, smoking cessation, and cautious discussion of PGT-A. Small deviations include protocol/adjuvant suggestions that are more speculative than guideline-driven.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, smoking cessation, protocol review, and nutritional counseling. It is useful, though some future-cycle suggestions are broad rather than highly individualized.
